relations: Camera forward motion enlarges the glass and pushes the peripheral table pencils toward the frame edges.
The red-and-white pencil in the glass retains its refracted, bent appearance at the water line.
The water surface and the pencils on the table remain stationary relative to the glass.
The dark wooden table and light-gray wall provide a static background during the camera's approach.
caption: The video showcases a clear glass partly filled with water resting on a dark wooden table against a plain light-gray wall. A red-and-white striped colored pencil leans inside the glass, its tip protruding above the rim. The submerged portion appears shifted at the water line, giving it a bent, discontinuous look. Other pencils lie flat on the table around the glass, a magenta-and-green group on the left and a yellow-and-blue group on the right. The camera slowly moves closer to the glass throughout, enlarging it and pushing the peripheral pencils toward the edges. The water surface and the pencils on the table do not shift, and the pencil's refracted look persists.
